title: Creekside Cavern
description:
Cozy, quiet guest suite boasting stone walls and two queen sized beds. The home is about 15 minutes to any destination in Music City. The space is private & has a keyless entry through the door at the lower level of the home. You'll have access to the back yard with a fire pit and a creek. The bathroom, kitchen, and coffee bar are stocked with the necessities.

The space
There are two bedrooms with comfortable queen-sized beds, a cozy living room, kitchen, bathroom, and dining area. 

The coffee bar is stocked with keurig pods, sugars & creamers, and various snacks. We've also got a coffee grinder and coffee machine if you prefer to brew something more fresh. Board games, a TV, and a creek are available for you to enjoy. 

The driveway is a down-hill slope worth considering if you have any mobility restrictions. 

The home is beneath the BNA flight path. We don't find the flyovers disruptive while inside the home, but they can be loud when a plane flies over while you're outside.

(The creek may be dry during summer months.)

Guest access
You'll receive your own private entry code. You'll have the entire basement guest suite to yourself, with two bedrooms, a full kitchen, bathroom, and living room. The back yard with a creek and fire pit are yours to enjoy as well (minus the shed). We live upstairs but the spaces are completely separate.

Drive times to local hot spots (may vary during peak hours): 

📍 10 minutes to Nashville Zoo
📍 15 minutes to BNA Airport
📍 15 min to Gulch
📍 15 min to Broadway
📍 15 min to Nissan Stadium
📍 15 min to Bridgestone Arena
📍 15 min to Ryman Auditorium
📍 20 min to The Grand Ole Opry
📍 20 min to Franklin

Other things to note
This is our home so please follow house rules and be respectful. Thank you for your interest!
